test.create_query: CREATE TABLE count_lc_nullable (k1m UInt32, k10m UInt64, s LowCardinality(Nullable(String)), sl LowCardinality(Nullable(String)), sf LowCardinality(Nullable(FixedString(8)))) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
test.fill_query: OPTIMIZE TABLE count_lc_nullable FINAL SETTINGS optimize_throw_if_noop = 1
test.query: SELECT count(s), count(sl) FROM count_lc_nullable SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT k1m, count(s) FROM count_lc_nullable GROUP BY k1m FORMAT Null
SELECT k10m, count(s), count(sl) FROM count_lc_nullable GROUP BY k10m FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 8
SELECT k1m % 10000 AS k, count(sl), count(sf) FROM count_lc_nullable GROUP BY k FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 4
test.drop_query: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS count_lc_nullable SYNC
